about: Labelled test set for the plain-code fact checker (services/checker.py). Each sentence is a realistic AI-assistant claim about the fictional seed catalog. 'expect' is the TRUTH, taken from the verified product facts, not from what the checker currently outputs: CORRECT = a true factual claim; a ruleId = the mistake the checker should flag; an empty list = no factual claim at all. Some cases use wording the checker is known not to handle yet (marked 'hard'), so the score is honest.
